sections.Profile:
Tom Tom , released by Williams Electronic Games in January 1963, is an electro-mechanical, two-player pinball machine designed by Steve Kordek, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1963
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Native Americans, Dancing, Original Theme, Single level playfield, Controversial
sections.Design Team:
- Art: George Molentin
- Design: Steve Kordek
sections.Editions: - Tom Tom: 1,300 made, released 1963-01-01, model number 272
